dataSource.fetchedBy: research agent, verified against the official source
dataSource.notes:
SOURCING / PROVENANCE. raisingcanes.com is behind Cloudflare and returns 403 to every non-browser fetch; the /nutrition and /allergens pages also render a blank body in a real browser (no PDF request is ever made — the official allergen page is effectively broken as of this run). I recovered the real document by pulling the Gatsby page payload at https://www.raisingcanes.com/page-data/allergens/page-data.json, which names the PDF Cane's itself embeds. That PDF is hosted on Cane's own Prismic CMS CDN and is titled "JULY 2025 | Nutritional & Allergen Information (WEB)". It is a first-party Raising Cane's document, so sourceIsOfficial=true. No aggregator was used at any point.

COLUMN MAPPING VERIFIED. The PDF's header row extracts out of order, so I confirmed the real data-row order (Name | Serving Size | Calories | Total Fat | Sat Fat | Trans Fat | Cholesterol | Sodium | Carbs | Fiber | Sugar | Protein | Allergen) with an Atwater cross-check on every item. All pass: fries 20x9+50x4+5x4=400 exactly; mayo 10x9=90 exactly; sandwich 41x9+69x4+47x4=833 vs 830; sauce 18x9+6x4=186 vs 190. Macros are verbatim from the PDF, not recomputed or reverse-engineered.

"< 1 g" HANDLING. The PDF prints "< 1 g" rather than a number for Honey Mustard protein; I recorded 0.5 g (midpoint). That is the only non-verbatim macro value in this menu.

PRESET TOTALS DO NOT EQUAL THE SUM OF THE LINE ITEMS — READ BEFORE VERIFYING. Cane's publishes combos as their own lab-analyzed rows, derived from combo-specific portions, not as the sum of the a la carte rows. The combo rows are internally consistent (Box Combo 72x9+98x4+62x4=1288 vs published 1290; Sandwich Combo 56x9+108x4+51x4=1140 exactly), so both sets of numbers are individually correct — they simply describe different portions. Summing my components will overshoot published calories by roughly 2-8%: Box 1360 vs 1290, 3 Finger 1130 vs 1050, Caniac 1810 vs 1840 (under), Sandwich 1230 vs 1140. Protein tracks much closer (Box 62 vs 62 exact, 3 Finger 48 vs 48 exact, Caniac 88 vs 90, Sandwich 52 vs 51). A recurring -11 g carb / -4.5 g fat offset across three combos suggests a smaller combo fries or toast portion that Cane's does not publish separately. I did not fudge any component to force the sums to reconcile.

COMBO TOTALS ARE DRINK-FREE. Each published combo figure equals the menu page's LOW end of its calorie range (Box 1290 of "1290-1720"), i.e. it assumes a zero-calorie drink. So these totals are directly usable as food-only numbers despite the combos nominally including a fountain drink.

UNRESOLVED CONFLICT ON THE SANDWICH. The nutrition PDF lists Chicken Sandwich at 830 Cal; raisingcanes.com/menu lists "Sandwich 780 Cal per sandwich". I used 830 because it is the only figure that comes with a full macro row, and mixing a calorie count from one source with macros from another would be worse. Flagging it as the one item worth re-checking when Cane's next updates the PDF.

STATION LAYOUT. Cane's has no true build-your-own line, so I mapped it to how you actually order: pick your chicken (fingers by the each, or the sandwich), add sides, add dips. Reused vocabulary ids throughout — mains, sides, dips (3-scoop cap fits Cane's extra-sauce ordering exactly), sauces. No new category ids invented.
